partners.mechanism_chain: THOC6 (HGNC:21922) —DISRUPTS→ Nuclear pore complex assembly and function; NDC1 (HGNC:14730) —DISRUPTS→ Nuclear pore complex assembly and function; Nuclear pore complex assembly and function —LEADS_TO→ ER-Golgi transport; ER-Golgi transport —LEADS_TO→ Achalasia (HP:0002064); ER-Golgi transport —LEADS_TO→ Polyneuropathy (HP:0004843); ER-Golgi transport —LEADS_TO→ Alacrima (HP:0011317); Nuclear pore complex assembly and function —LEADS_TO→ Global developmental delay (HP:0001263). Loss-of-function mutations in THOC6 (associated with MONDO:0013362) and NDC1 (associated with MONDO:0979875) both disrupt the function of the nuclear pore complex. falsification.text: The proposed mechanism would be falsified if variants in THOC6 were found to be exclusively gain-of-function or dominant-negative in MONDO:0013362, or if NDC1 variants were found to be exclusively gain-of-function or dominant-negative in MONDO:0979875, as this would contradict the shared loss-of-function hypothesis. Additionally, if experimental evidence demonstrated that THOC6 and NDC1 function in completely independent cellular pathways that do not converge on nuclear pore complex or ER-Golgi transport, this hypothesis would be weakened.
